Subject: Delays in order processing for regular SEA orders

 

Dear all,

 

I wanted to flag something that is affecting our shipments right now. We have seen a real increase in customs checks on our end. These inspections can be both administrative and physical.

 

The physical inspections can take up to a month to clear. Luckily, we have had only one so far: invoice 202741824.
